game_concept: A speed quiz set in Mt. Pyre – Fire Shrine, an ancient fire shrine: the ash ranger must handle cinder bats while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Modulo Gate: Use % to decide which gates in Fire Shrine open (even, odd, divisible by 3).
theme: Mt. Pyre – Fire Shrine: an ancient fire shrine
core_gameplay_loop: Inspect the circuit board, solve the CP1 station, and advance the signal through its gates.
secondary_mechanics: Bonus coins for fast correct moves
player_objective: Print every even number from 26 through 50. Trace the update by 2 and the final failed condition. Test dataset 8: {}; {}.
controls: Drag the flowchart symbols into connected positions, then Check chart.
win_condition: Construct a complete chart that passes every executable input/output case.
lose_condition: The available unsuccessful chart checks are exhausted.
assets_style: Shared Kenney CC0 tile and audio assets with deterministic Canvas layouts; assets are not duplicated per game.
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Modulo Gate' (Week 2 slot 3), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Fire Shrine'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Use terminator, input/output, process and decision symbols.
Test the chart with every example input.
source_player_objective: Collect 380 points of heat shields by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
source_lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 380, or lives reach 0.
hint: Follow the input through each operation. Compare every output, including negative inputs.
